passive.name: Long Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Skill and Ultimate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate, gains "Somnus Corpus." Upon triggering a Follow-Up ATK, consumes "Somnus Corpus," and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **48/56/64/72/80%**.

passive.name: Longing
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. The Ultimate DMG and Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by the wearer increase by **24/28/32/36/40%**.

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: Each Now Has a Role to Play
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **24/30/36/42/48%** for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Get Ready
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by **4/5/6/7/8%**, stacking up to **3** time(s).

substatLine: Speed > CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%
tracePriority: War Marshal (A6) > Battalia Crush (A2) > Savant Providence (A4)

entries.name: Glistening Light
entries.text: Jing Yuan deals Lightning DMG equal to **100%** of his ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Rifting Zenith
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **100%** of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by **2** for the next turn.

entries.name: Lightbringer
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **200%** of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by **3** for the next turn.

entries.name: Prana Extirpated
entries.text:
Summons "Lightning-Lord" at the start of the battle. "Lightning-Lord" has **60** base SPD and **3** base Hits Per Action. When the Lightning-Lord takes action, its hits are considered as Follow-Up ATKs, with each hit dealing Lightning DMG equal to **66%** of Jing Yuan's ATK to a random single enemy, and enemies adjacent to it also receive Lightning DMG equal to **25%** of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy.
The Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action can reach a max of **10**. Every time "Lightning-Lord's" Hits Per Action increases by 1, its SPD increases by **10**. After the "Lightning-Lord's" action ends, its SPD and Hits Per Action return to their base values.
When Jing Yuan is knocked down, the "Lightning-Lord" will disappear.
When Jing Yuan is affected by Crowd Control debuff, the "Lightning-Lord" is unable to take action.

entries.name: Spiritus Invocation
entries.text: After the Technique is used, the Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action in the first turn increases by **3** at the start of the next battle.

entries.name: Battalia Crush
entries.text: If the Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action is greater or equal to **6** in the next turn, its CRIT DMG increases by **25%** for the next turn.

entries.name: Savant Providence
entries.text: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates **15** Energy.

entries.name: War Marshal
entries.text: After the Skill is used, the CRIT Rate increases by **10%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Slash, Seas Split
entries.text: When Lightning-Lord attacks, the DMG multiplier on enemies adjacent to the target enemy increases by an extra amount equal to 25% of the DMG multiplier against the primary target enemy.

entries.name: Swing, Skies Squashed
entries.text: After Lightning-Lord takes action, DMG dealt by Jing Yuan's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate increases by 20%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Strike, Suns Subdued
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Spin, Stars Sieged
entries.text: For each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action, Jing Yuan regenerates 2 Energy.

entries.name: Stride, Spoils Seized
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Sweep, Souls Slain
entries.text:
Each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action will make the target enemy Vulnerable.
While Vulnerable, enemies receive 12% more DMG until the end of the Lightning-Lord's current turn, stacking up to 3 time(s).
